detail.body:
This PR lets Megatron-LM's attention take the fused single-QKV RoPE path with per-head Q/K RMSNorm by passing the TE RMSNorm weights into `apply_fused_qkv_rotary_pos_emb`, instead of splitting QKV and running the norm and RoPE separately.

It relies on [this TE PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/pull/3673) that lets that kernel apply the norm; with an older TE, or with L2Norm/LayerNorm QK-norms, nothing changes and the split path stays.

The tests compare fused vs split attention outputs and gradients on the same layer, and replay forward and backward bit-exactly (registered in the kernel determinism manifest).

         """Specialized attention subclasses retain their atomic forward path."""
         return type(self).forward is Attention.forward
 
+    def qk_norm_fusable_into_qkv_rope(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether the Q/K norms can be folded into TE's fused single-QKV RoPE kernel.
+
+        The kernel applies a per-head RMSNorm with a learnable `[kv_channels]` weight before
+        the rotation, so both norms must be Transformer Engine `RMSNorm` modules over the head
+        dimension with the same epsilon and `zero_centered_gamma`. The fused path applies no
+        YaRN concentration factor, so the config must not request one either.
+        """
+        if not HAVE_FUSED_QKV_NORM_ROPE or self._yarn_concentration_factor != 1.0:
+            return False
+        norms = (self.q_layernorm, self.k_layernorm)
+        if not all(isinstance(norm, TERMSNorm) for norm in norms):
+            return False
+        if any(norm.weight.numel() != self.hidden_size_per_attention_head for norm in norms):
+            return False
+        return (
+            self.q_layernorm.eps == self.k_layernorm.eps
+            and self.q_layernorm.zero_centered_gamma == self.k_layernorm.zero_centered_gamma
+        )
+
+    def _fused_qkv_rope_norm_kwargs(self) -> dict:
+        """Norm arguments of `apply_fused_qkv_rotary_pos_emb` when the Q/K norms are fused in.
+
+        The norm modules' forward is not called on this path, so their forward pre-hooks
+        (DistributedDataParallel uses them to wait for the parameter all-gather) are run here
+        explicitly, as the fused MoE experts do for their linear layers.
+        """
+        if self.q_layernorm is None or isinstance(self.q_layernorm, IdentityOp):
+            return {}
+        for norm in (self.q_layernorm, self.k_layernorm):
+            for hook_id, hook in list(norm._forward_pre_hooks.items()):
+                if hook_id in norm._forward_pre_hooks_with_kwargs:
+                    ret = hook(norm, (), {})
+                else:
+                    ret = hook(norm, None)
+                if ret is not None:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"{norm.__class__.__name__} has a forward pre-hook that modifies its "
+                        "input, which is not supported when the QK norm is fused into RoPE."
+                    )
+        return dict(
+            q_norm_weight=self.q_layernorm.weight,
+            k_norm_weight=self.k_layernorm.weight,
+            norm_eps=self.q_layernorm.eps,
+            norm_zero_centered_gamma=self.q_layernorm.zero_centered_gamma,
+        )

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Replay SelfAttention with the Q/K RMSNorm fused into TE's single-QKV RoPE kernel.
+
+With ``qk_layernorm`` and ``fused_single_qkv_rope`` the attention layer hands the norm weights
+to Transformer Engine's fused QKV RoPE, whose Triton kernels normalize and rotate in one pass
+and reduce the weight gradients in a fixed order. Forward, input gradient and the norm weight
+gradients must therefore replay bit-exactly, also under side-stream contention.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.unit_tests.determinism.kernels.harness import assert_module_replays_bit_exact, seeded
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA and Transformer Engine")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("contention", [False, True])
+def test_fused_qkv_norm_rope_attention_replays(contention, monkeypatch):
+    """Replay forward/backward of a QK-norm attention layer on the fused single-QKV path."""
+    from megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine import HAVE_TE
+
+    if not HAVE_TE:
+        pytest.skip("requires Transformer Engine")
+
+    from megatron.core.transformer.attention import HAVE_FUSED_QKV_NORM_ROPE
+
+    if not HAVE_FUSED_QKV_NORM_ROPE:
+        pytest.skip("the installed Transformer Engine cannot fuse the QK norm into RoPE")
+
+    from megatron.core.models.common.embeddings.rotary_pos_embedding import RotaryEmbedding
+    from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_layer_specs import (
+        get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_submodules,
+    )
+    from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+    from megatron.core.transformer.attention import SelfAttention
+    from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnMaskType
+    from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+    from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel()
+    try:
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)
+        seeded()
+        monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_ALLOW_NONDETERMINISTIC_ALGO", "0")
+        config = TransformerConfig(
+            num_layers=1,
+            hidden_size=512,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            num_query_groups=2,
+            kv_channels=128,
+            bf16=True,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            attention_dropout=0.0,
+            hidden_dropout=0.0,
+            add_bias_linear=False,
+            normalization="RMSNorm",
+            qk_layernorm=True,
+            fused_single_qkv_rope=True,
+            deterministic_mode=True,
+        )
+        module = SelfAttention(
+            config,
+            get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_submodules(
+                qk_layernorm=True
+            ).self_attention.submodules,
+            layer_number=1,
+            attn_mask_type=AttnMaskType.causal,
+        ).cuda()
+        assert module.qk_norm_fusable_into_qkv_rope()
+
+        seq_length, batch_size = 512, 2
+        hidden = torch.randn(
+            seq_length, batch_size, config.hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        rotary = RotaryEmbedding(kv_channels=config.kv_channels, rotary_percent=1.0)(seq_length)
+        inputs = dict(
+            hidden_states=hidden.requires_grad_(True), attention_mask=None, rotary_pos_emb=rotary
+        )
+        outputs, grads = assert_module_replays_bit_exact(
+            module,
+            inputs,
+            replays=3,
+            contention=contention,
+            what="SelfAttention with the QK norm fused into single-QKV RoPE",
+        )
+        assert "in.hidden_states" in grads
+        assert any("q_layernorm" in name for name in grads)
+        assert any("k_layernorm" in name for name in grads)
+        for tensors in (outputs, grads):
+            assert all(torch.isfinite(t).all() for t in tensors.values())
+    finally:
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()

 class TestParallelAttention:
@@ -152,6 +154,58 @@ def test_fused_rope_gpu_forward(self, rotary_interleaved, fused_qkv_rope):
         self.parallel_attention.config.apply_rope_fusion = False
         self.parallel_attention.config.rotary_interleaved = False
 
+    @pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not HAVE_FUSED_QKV_NORM_ROPE, reason="TE fused QKV RoPE cannot apply the QK norm."
+    )
+    def test_fused_qkv_rope_with_qk_layernorm(self):
+        if self.transformer_config.attention_output_gate:
+            pytest.skip("Fused QKV RoPE does not support gated attention for now.")
+        config = copy.deepcopy(self.transformer_config)
+        config.normalization = "RMSNorm"
+        config.qk_layernorm = True
+        config.apply_rope_fusion = True
+        config.attention_dropout = 0.0
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)
+        attention = SelfAttention(
+            config,
+            get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_submodules(
+                qk_layernorm=True
+            ).self_attention.submodules,
+            layer_number=1,
+            attn_mask_type=AttnMaskType.causal,
+        ).cuda()
+        assert attention.qk_norm_fusable_into_qkv_rope()
+
+        sequence_length, micro_batch_size = 32, 2
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(
+            (sequence_length, micro_batch_size, config.hidden_size),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        rotary_pos_emb = torch.rand(sequence_length, 1, 1, config.kv_channels, device="cuda")
+
+        results = {}
+        for fused in (False, True):
+            attention.config.fused_single_qkv_rope = fused
+            attention.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            output, _ = attention(hidden_states, None, rotary_pos_emb=rotary_pos_emb)
+            assert torch.isfinite(output).all()
+            output.float().sum().backward()
+            results[fused] = (
+                output.detach().clone(),
+                attention.q_layernorm.weight.grad.clone(),
+                attention.k_layernorm.weight.grad.clone(),
+                attention.linear_qkv.weight.grad.clone(),
+            )
+        # The split path rounds the normalized Q/K to bf16 before the rotation and the fused
+        # path rounds once, so the two agree up to bf16 rounding of the Q/K values, which the
+        # attention and the weight-gradient reductions spread over elements of any magnitude.
+        for split_result, fused_result in zip(results[False], results[True]):
+            expected = split_result.float()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                fused_result.float(), expected, rtol=1.6e-2, atol=1e-2 * expected.abs().max().item()
+            )
+
     def test_checkpointed_gpu_forward(self):
         transformer_config = self.transformer_config
         transformer_config.recompute_granularity = 'selective'
